parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query only zero-extract, transform, load (ETL) integration tasks. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-full-process-list --dts-job-id i03e3zty16i0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeFullProcessList --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId i03e3zty16i0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
